nodes.summary: There do not exist a real number $C > 0$ and a natural number $k$ such that for all positive integers $n$ and $m$ and every real $n \times m$ matrix $A$ there is a set $L$ of at most $m^k$ sign vectors in $\{-1, 1\}^m$ with the following property: for every set $S$ of columns of $A$ some $\varepsilon \in L$ satisfies $\left|\sum_{j \in S} A_{ij} \varepsilon_j\right| \le C \operatorname{herdisc}(A)$ for every row…
nodes.title: The polynomial-size colouring list conjecture is false

nodes.summary: The statement that there exist a real number $C > 0$ and a natural number $k$ such that for all positive integers $n$ and $m$ and every real $n \times m$ matrix $A$ there is a set $L$ of at most $m^k$ sign vectors in $\{-1, 1\}^m$ with the following property: for every set $S$ of columns of $A$ some $\varepsilon \in L$ satisfies $\left|\sum_{j \in S} A_{ij} \varepsilon_j\right| \le C \operatorname{herdisc}(A)$ for…
nodes.title: Polynomial-size colouring list conjecture

nodes.summary: For a real $n \times m$ matrix $A$ and a set $S$ of columns of $A$, the discrepancy of $A$ on $S$ is the minimum, over all sign vectors $\varepsilon \in \{-1, 1\}^m$, of $\max_i \left|\sum_{j \in S} A_{ij} \varepsilon_j\right|$, the largest absolute value of a row sum of $A$ restricted to $S$ and weighted by $\varepsilon$ (taken to be $0$ when $A$ has no rows).
nodes.title: Discrepancy of a matrix on a set of columns

nodes.summary: The hereditary discrepancy $\operatorname{herdisc}(A)$ of a real $n \times m$ matrix $A$ is the maximum, over all sets $S$ of columns of $A$, of the discrepancy of $A$ on $S$.
nodes.title: Hereditary discrepancy of a real matrix

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
